g.text: Native Fedora/KDE WireGuard controller built around

Collaborative lists, budgets, item claiming, and live updates
across a Flutter client and a .NET backend.

an LL(1) parser, FIRST/FOLLOW, and parse-tree views.
Search, Monte Carlo simulation, optimization, neural nets,
convolution, pooling, and introductory computer vision.
